integrity: Exact finite covariance from the stationary Lyapunov integral and a uniform local-central-limit proof. An independent audit or independent replication has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional convergence for an open one-way linear Gaussian chain only; no nonlinear, feedback, periodic-boundary or general spatially varying noise conclusions. Previously known infinite-chain variance thresholds are credited to the literature. Publication-priority assessment is incomplete beyond the inspected sources.
title: Mesoscopic spatial covariance at the exceptional-point threshold of a noisy directed chain
